title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, now out of beta and ready to empower you with its full suite of capabilities.

title: Enhanced File Control in the Editor
summary: Seamlessly manage and customize all your files directly within the editor, with new capabilities to upload, download, and control their visual presentation.

title: Public Roadmap
summary: Stay informed with our new public roadmap, providing transparent updates on completed features, what's coming next, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, streamlining your workflow with a modern, intuitive design.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Our latest enhancements deliver a more intuitive and transparent real-time collaboration experience, making teamwork smoother and more efficient than ever before.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: We've made it significantly easier to discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, ensuring all relevant content from your connections is readily accessible.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: We are opening Noeko's codebase to foster an unparalleled level of community control, collaboration, and transparency in shaping the project's future.

title: Go Global with Multilingual Support
summary: We're expanding Noeko to support a world of languages, making it accessible and enjoyable for users everywhere.

title: Elevating Your Workspace with Stunning Themes
summary: We're launching a collection of vibrant new themes and significantly enhancing our existing ones to give your workspace a beautiful, personalized refresh.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Experience a revitalized knowledge map that empowers you to effortlessly explore, filter by tags and time, and share insights with your network, turning it into a powerful workflow starter.

title: Curate Your Knowledge with Advanced Search
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge with advanced filters, flexible sorting capabilities, and the convenience of saving your tailored searches for future access.

title: Flexible Content Displays
summary: Gain greater control over how you view and interact with linked content, allowing you to structure your notes in a way that truly reflects your thought process.

title: Noeko: Flexible Hosting and Advanced Plans
summary: Unlock Noeko's full potential with the introduction of new plans, offering the flexibility to host on your own servers or choose premium cloud-based access with enhanced features.

title: Precise Daily Greetings
summary: Enjoy perfectly timed greetings on your homepage, as we're making sure they always match the current time of day for a seamless experience.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Streamline your workflow by effortlessly removing items from tags and performing other key actions directly within the tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Get ready to easily capture and organize insights from an expanded array of sources, including YouTube videos, websites, and plain text, all within a unified experience.
